title: Trinity Marine Station - Project Status Manifest
description: Agentic-first marine navigation station. Real-time ingestion of vessel telemetry, JEPA-style anomaly detection, local LLM narration, and a WebSocket A2A bridge to a future Eclipse Theia workspace.
_comment: Update 'generated_at' whenever this file is edited. Update 'commit' to the latest shipped commit hash (HEAD on main, when working tree is clean).
name: trinity-marine-station

sibling_repo.name: vessel-agent
sibling_repo.role: L0/L1 data capture (NMEA, acoustic, catch); upstream of Trinity's L2 cognitive layer

language: JavaScript (Node.js, plain JS with JSDoc; no build step)

3002.purpose: A2A bridge fanout (validated workspace mutations to subscribers)

6.title: unassigned
candidates: Theia extension (TypeScript frontend that consumes the A2A bridge)
Real vessel-agent Python WS bridge (publishes trinity delta at :3000)
DuckDB read-side adapter for retrospective queries

backend/a2aBridge.js.purpose: WebSocket server on port 3002. Validates A2AAction payloads, assigns monotonic ids, persists to A2aLog, broadcasts to all clients with replay/ack/ping/pong.

backend/a2aClient.js.purpose: Typed WS client. Hello handshake, monotonic action IDs, auto-reconnect with exponential backoff, manual requestReplay, destroy.

backend/a2aLog.js.purpose: Append-only JSONL audit log. Batched writes, rotation, replay, persistence, ack checkpointing.

backend/vesselAgentAdapter.js.purpose: Anti-corruption layer. Normalizes Signal K deltas and vessel-agent core_anchor JSON into canonical TrinityFrame.

backend/trinityDaemon.js.purpose: Production daemon. Wires ingest to JEPA to narrator to a2aLog to a2aBridge. Serves /health (liveness) and /status (snapshot). Reads all env vars.

backend/schemas.js.purpose: Single source of truth for every wire shape. Validators throw on rejected input. Add new validators here.

backend/llmNarrator.js.purpose: Conscious narrator. Splits LLM stream into prose and <a2a>...</a2a> blocks. Throttled normal mode, instant emergency mode.

backend/jepaWorldModel.js.purpose: Linear predictor over feature vectors. Emits energy score 0..1; >0.5 = anomaly.

backend/trinityCore.js.purpose: Orchestrator. Polls ring buffer every 500ms, feeds JEPA, branches on energy (peaceful -> throttled narrator; anomaly -> emergency narrator).

backend/llmBackends.js.purpose: Pluggable LlmBackend. HttpLlmBackend for local Ollama, OpenAiCompatibleBackend for cloud, MockLlmBackend for tests.

backend/telemetryIngest.js.purpose: WebSocket consumer. Connects to :3000, hello handshake, exponential backoff reconnect, parses deltas into feature vectors.

backend/ringBuffer.js.purpose: Pre-allocated Float64Array ring buffer (256 x 6 = 12 KB). Zero per-frame allocation.

backend/vectorStore.js.purpose: In-memory Float32Array cosine/dot/L2 store. Auto-grows. EmbeddingRetriever wraps text queries with pluggable embedFn.

backend/circuitBreaker.js.purpose: 3-state breaker (closed/open/half-open). exec() for sync, execStream() for async iterables. AbortSignal-aware.

backend/healthCheck.js.purpose: Probe runner + status aggregator. Bounded by probe timeout. Returns {status: ok|degraded|down, probes: [...]}

backend/h3.js.purpose: Lightweight H3-style indexer (drop-in compatible with h3-js API). Quantized-grid approximation; replace with h3-js for production-grade.

backend/navigationSimulator.js.purpose: Pure stateful world model. Lat/lon/heading/depth over the SF Bay trajectory. Transport-agnostic.

backend/mockSignalK.js.purpose: WebSocket broadcaster on ws://127.0.0.1:3000. 2 Hz. Synthetic Signal K deltas. Drop-in replacement for a real Signal K server.

backend/marineConstants.js.purpose: Single source of truth: SF Bay trajectory waypoints, depth field, feature-vector layout.

events.convention: Use constants from shared/events.js, never string literals.

BRIDGE_DISABLED.purpose: set to 1 to skip bridge startup

lint.policy: console.log forbidden in non-CLI backend modules (allow-list: mockSignalK.js, telemetryIngest.js, llmNarrator.js, trinityDaemon.js). console.warn and console.error permitted elsewhere.

gotchas: The bridge still broadcasts before the log write resolves (a2aLog.append is fire-and-forget for latency). Documented in docs/PHASE5.md §6.
Use opts.port ?? DEFAULT_PORT, not opts.port || DEFAULT_PORT. Otherwise port: 0 is silently rewritten.
PowerShell does not support &&. Use ; or run commands in separate calls.
daemon.test.js teardown requires bridge.stop() to prevent event loop hang.
Unicode characters in record_note payloads break on Windows (charmap encoding). Use ASCII.
A2aLog is durable across instances; '_listLogFiles()' reads the entire directory.
Sub-second GPS interpolation belongs to vessel-agent (Python), not Trinity.
Lint forbids console.log in most backend modules. Allow-list: mockSignalK, telemetryIngest, llmNarrator, trinityDaemon.
Don't add a TypeScript build step. Plain JS + JSDoc only. Theia is the only TS allowed.
Every event name must come from shared/events.js. Never string literals.

phase_6_candidates.title: Theia extension
phase_6_candidates.why: Closes the L3 -> L4 loop. The bridge fans out but no UI listens. ~200 LOC TS.

phase_6_candidates.title: Sync-then-broadcast bridge
phase_6_candidates.why: Crash-recovery correctness. Trades ~5ms latency for durability. ~30 LOC.

phase_6_candidates.title: Real vessel-agent Python WS bridge
phase_6_candidates.why: Replaces the mock with the real upstream. ~80 LOC Python.

phase_6_candidates.title: DuckDB read-side adapter
phase_6_candidates.why: Retrospective queries against archived features. ~150 LOC.

phase_6_candidates.title: h3-js integration
phase_6_candidates.why: Drop-in replacement for the quantized-grid approximation. ~50 LOC.
